description: This file defines data models, enums, constants, and utility functions for configuring and rendering liquid level indicator widgets in the Thingsboard platform. It includes widget settings interfaces, SVG shape mappings, unit conversions, and form validation logic.

classes.name: SvgInfo
classes.description: Interface representing SVG information including the SVG string and its limits.

classes.name: SvgLimits
classes.description: Interface representing the minimum and maximum limits for an SVG shape.

classes.name: LevelCardWidgetSettings
classes.description: Interface extending WidgetConfig with specific settings for liquid level indicator widgets.

methods.name: convertLiters
methods.description: Converts a volume value to or from liters based on specified units and conversion type.

methods.name: extractValue
methods.description: Extracts a value of generic type T from an array of AttributeData by attribute key.

methods.name: createAbsoluteLayout
methods.description: Generates an HTML string for absolute layout display of volume and units.

methods.name: createPercentLayout
methods.description: Generates an HTML string for percentage layout display.

methods.name: optionsFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter function for DataKey objects based on search text.

methods.name: fetchEntityKeysForDevice
methods.description: Fetches entity keys for a device ID and specified data key types.

methods.name: fetchEntityKeys
methods.description: Fetches entity keys based on an alias ID and data key types, using an alias controller.

methods.name: createShapeLayout
methods.description: Creates a sanitized SVG URL with layout modifications based on the shape SVG and layout type.

methods.name: loadSvgShapesMapping
methods.description: Loads SVG shape mappings from resources service and returns a map of shape to SVG string.

methods.name: updatedFormSettingsValidators
methods.description: Adjusts form validation and enabling/disabling of controls based on widget settings.
